pages.ja:
疾走。停止。一撃。
キャスターの神言を全て弾き返し、誰にも対抗する隙を与えず、セイバーは勝負を決した。
踏み込む速度、大地に落とした足捌き、横一文字に振り抜いた剣に是非はない。
彼女の視えない剣は敵マスターを一閃した。
最高の機を窺っての奇襲である。
斬撃は大木を断つほどの会心さで、仕損じる事なく葛木宗一郎を二つに分ける。

pages.en:
A charge. A halt. A single stroke.

Saber repels every divine word Caster hurls at her and settles the battle before anyone has the slightest chance to resist.

There is no fault in the speed of her advance, the foot she plants against the earth, or the sword she sweeps in one level arc.

Her invisible blade flashes through the enemy Master.

The ambush has come at the perfect instant.

The stroke is true enough to fell a great tree. Without the least chance of failure, it cuts Souichirou Kuzuki in two.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Charge. Stop. Slash.
Having repelled all of Caster’s spells, Saber settled the match without giving anybody a chance to stop her.
The charging speed, her footwork, and her attack were perfect.
Her invisible sword slashed the enemy Master.
A surprise attack at the perfect moment.
Saber’s powerful slash splits Kuzuki Souichirou in two.

“What—”

A breath escapes her in confusion.

What has happened?

Still frozen in the posture of her completed stroke, Saber herself stares blankly at the enemy before her.

横一線になぎ払った必殺の一撃。
それが止まっている。
敵の胴体を薙ぎ払う直前に、何かに刀身を挟まれて停止している。

“—Impossible.”

Even she cannot grasp what has happened.

Her killing stroke, swept in a horizontal line—

has stopped.

Something has caught the blade an instant before it can tear through the enemy's body.

“
No… way.”

The attack is stopped.
The sword has stopped before slashing the enemy’s body, being caught between something.

膝と肘。
高速で斬り払われるソレを、男は片方の膝と肘で、挟み込むように止めていたのだ。

“—His leg… and arm?”

Can such an absurd miracle exist?

Her sword has been stopped by the enemy, Souichirou Kuzuki.

Knee and elbow.

The man has clamped the blade between one knee and one elbow, catching it in the midst of its high-speed sweep.

Knee and elbow…

Of course, she does not know.

She has never heard of a martial art that catches an opponent's weapon—a naked blade—with the bare body, nor of masters capable of such a feat.

Even so, had this been an ordinary battle, she would never have stood there dumbfounded.

But still, she would not have stood there in astonishment if this were a normal fight.

Her opponent is, in the end, only human.

For a mere man to catch an invisible blade in the midst of its killing stroke, then hold it fast with his unprotected limbs—there is no sanity in it…!
pages.mirrorMoon:

For him to stop an invisible sword with his bare body… he must be insane…!

pages.en:

But the enemy does not pursue.

Caster's Master—the man who ought to be helpless once targeted—remains planted where he stood,

and drives a blow through her solar plexus.
pages.mirrorMoon:

It is an established rule to pursue a retreating enemy.
But the enemy does not pursue her.
Caster’s Master, the man who will be defeated if he stays there, does not move, and…
He pierces her through her solar plexus.

The fists cannot be evaded, but no single blow carries overwhelming force.

The next blow exploits that fractional opening and snaps at the back of her head, seeking to reap consciousness by the roots. It calls to mind the scythe of death.

男が狙うのは、剥き出しである彼女の顔だ。
pages.en:
“Ah—”

Her consciousness falls away.

The blow to the back of her head sends shock flooding through her brain.

“Kh—!”

Even so, she raises both arms.

The man's attacks cannot break through her armor.

Then he will aim for the one place left bare—her face.

”

The impact landing on the back of her head shakes her brain.
“Kuh
!”
But she still manages to raise her hands.
The man’s attacks cannot penetrate through her armor.
Then
the man will go for her bared head.

肘先から変化し、左側面から後頭部を狙ってくる一撃に備えた。
もはや、この相手を侮る事などできない。
相手が意識を刈り獲るというのなら獲らせる。

pages.en:
She slips back just far enough to evade it and tightens both hands upon her sword.

She prepares for what comes next: the blow changing at the elbow to sweep from her left into the back of her head.

—She can no longer afford to underestimate this opponent.

If he means to reap her consciousness, she will let him.

But immediately afterward, she will claim both his arms in payment.

Her eyes fly open—and widen in horror at the change before her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Saber avoids it by retreating a bit and grips her sword.
The course of the fist after that.
She readies herself for the blow that will go for the back of her head from the left side.
She cannot make light of him anymore.
If the enemy is to take her consciousness, she will let him.
But she will cut down his arms as compensation. She opens her eyes wide and…
…She is astonished at the change.

“Guh…!”

The impact falls upon her shoulder.

The instant she glares at her enemy, certain that her left shoulder has been utterly destroyed, a chill runs the length of her spine.

“Guh…!”
The impact lands on her shoulder.
She glares at her enemy with her left shoulder destroyed… and her spine freezes up the instant she does so.

pages.en:
The man's body wheels, one side drawing sharply back.

His right arm—the one he has not used even once until now.

The right fist that has remained poised at the height of her throat launches like a cannonball.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The man moves back half of his body.
His right hand that has not been used yet…
The fist that has been set at the height of her throat is released like a cannon.

」

正面にいるセイバーに対して、一直線に放たれる打突の拳。
その威力、針の穴ほども通す精密さを持つこの男なら、貫ける。
溜めに溜めた渾身の一撃ならば、セイバーの喉を貫き骨を断ち、完膚無きまでに頭を飛ばすに容易すぎる
！

pages.en:
“—”

Until now, his attacks have been lines. At last, they become a point.

A thrusting fist fired straight at Saber, standing directly before him.

This man possesses the precision to pass through an opening no larger than a needle's eye. With it, the blow can pierce her.

With all the power he has stored behind it, piercing Saber's throat, breaking her spine, and tearing her head from her body would be almost contemptuously easy—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
Unlike the previous attacks that followed a line, this attack is executed as a point.
A thrusting fist aimed at the person in front of him.
With his force and precise accuracy, he should be able to pierce through her.
With his charged attack, it should be easy to pierce Saber’s throat, break her bone, and smash her head to pieces
!

“—!!!!!!!”

But even that fails.

A surprise attack cannot overcome her instinct, which borders upon foreknowledge.

The serpent's fist grazes the side of her neck.

She watches it pass and steps forward to turn her blade upon him.

At that instant—

Crack.

An impossible sound comes from beside her throat.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
!!!!!!”
But it misses.
A surprise attack is useless on her, as she has instincts bordering on precognition.
The snake-like fist grazes past her neck.
Seeing that, she tries to step in to attack, but at that moment…
Bam!
An unbelievable sound comes from right beside her neck.

pages.en:
The serpent's fangs sink in.

The hand that grazed Saber's neck drives its fingers into her flesh at the very instant the thrust is evaded.

“—That piercing needle… it was an anchor…!”

Astonishment races through her and becomes terror.

Yes. A hand is not, by nature, made to strike. It is made to seize.

Perhaps aided by Caster's magical energy, the enemy's fingers begin crushing Saber's throat with appalling ease…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
The snake’s fang pierces her.
The instant it is dodged, the attack that passed her uses its fingers to dig into her neck with a sound.
“Anchor…!”
The shock passes through her as a shudder.
Yes. A hand is originally something used to grab, not punch.
It must be supported by Caster’s magic as the enemy’s fingers easily squeeze off her neck…!

Before she can swing the sword, her own body is swung like a blade.

The sensation of leaving the ground.

An overhand pitch.

Still gripping Saber by the throat, the man hurls her away with one arm.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But she is unable to finish her attack.
Before the sword is swung, her body itself is swung like a sword.
She feels her body fly through the air.
An overswing like a pitcher.
The man holds on to Saber’s neck, and he throws her with one arm.

pages.en:
A human body cast like a fastball.

There is no possibility of breaking her fall.

Thrown with the flesh of her throat tearing away, she smashes into a concrete wall at two hundred kilometers per hour.

“Ah… —”

Her body goes utterly still.
pages.mirrorMoon:
A fastball with a human as the ball.
There is no way she can land safely from it.
Her neck is scraped off, and she is smashed into a concrete wall at a speed of two hundred kilometers per hour.
“Ah……
”
Her body is forced to stop its action.
